summary: Tested Collaborative Democracy Lab full-stack. Backend pytest: 19/19 passing (auth, examples, AI opposing/concerns/needs/solutions, maps CRUD, ownership isolation, unauth 401s). Frontend Playwright: full wizard E2E verified — register, protected-route redirect, starter examples (6), Issue Input with AI opposing-position generation, Position Mapping with suggest-concerns chips, Needs auto-gen + add/remove, Solutions generation (3-5 cards), Reflection, Save, Copy, Download Markdown, Export PDF, Save & Finish navigation, Dashboard saved map, Open map -> reflection with data, Delete map. AI calls (Claude sonnet-4-6 via emergentintegrations) all returned valid structured data within 5-15s.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased on register/login but not documented in the response shape that mirrors input. Not a bug, just behavior to note for clients.

Brute-force lockout key is per (client.host + email). Behind a proxy/ingress, request.client.host may be the ingress IP — could cause global lockouts under shared NAT. Consider using X-Forwarded-For for the rate-limit key.
PUT/GET/DELETE do not validate ObjectId format; invalid hex strings would raise bson InvalidId -> 500. Wrap with try/except and return 404.

issues: Save & Finish triggers a fresh save even if a prior Save was just clicked — could double-create. Worth disabling Save&Finish if a map id is already set OR using the existing id (currently saveAndFinish always calls save). Confirmed not duplicating because save() uses PUT when map.id exists, but flow could be smoother.

action_items: Optional: Harden /api/maps/{map_id} endpoints against invalid ObjectId (currently would 500).
Optional: Use X-Forwarded-For for login lockout key to avoid shared-IP global lockouts.
Optional: Disable Save & Finish briefly during save to avoid accidental double-submit on slow networks.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth cookies: samesite='none', secure=True is correct for cross-site cookie usage; verified working with the preview HTTPS domain.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via _serialize_map and explicit pop in get_current_user.
Pydantic models validate AI input shapes; AI endpoints wrap errors in 500 with details — fine for dev, consider sanitizing in prod.
Bcrypt hashes verified ($2b$ format) and seed_admin uses idempotent update if password changed — passes auth playbook checks.
CORS: allow_origins is explicit list with FRONTEND_URL — good. allow_credentials=True works.
No file-size violations. Code is modular (llm.py, examples.py, server.py).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (21/21 across two runs; first run's only fail was test-side timeout, retested OK)

seed_data_creation: Test users created via /api/auth/register with TEST_/test_ prefix; created and deleted test maps during the run. Admin account is seeded on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). AI calls can be slow (5-20s) — use generous timeouts. Note: backend lowercases emails on register; tests must use lowercase comparisons. data-testids are well populated throughout the wizard.
rca of the issue: First Playwright run reported 1 'failure' for navigation after finish-button click; root cause was the test using a 10s navigation timeout while the save() call + navigate completed slightly later. Verified working in a focused retest with 20s timeout. No app-side bug.
